metadata.title: MAPP 4601.3 Rev.2 Children in the Workplace
metadata.legal_basis: CDER Manual of Policies and Procedures (internal FDA review procedure). Informative; not binding on applicants.

DEFINITIONS CDER Employee: For the purpose of this MAPP, an individual who is appointed in the civil service, or assigned to the Commissioned Corps to work for CDER. A person engaged in the performance of a Federal function under authority of law or an executive act.

candidates.statement: 1. Employees are required to assure their children stay within visual range at all times.
candidates.context: Employee Responsibilities: 2. Employees must not allow their children to be left unattended in copy rooms, break rooms, hallways, conference rooms, or any common areas. This includes the common areas outside of FDA-occupied structures.
